evals.prompt: Scenario: the argument is `We just launched our new product after 6 months of work`. Show the full output you would give the user. You cannot run commands or ask questions. Write the complete output exactly as an agent with full access would, using this scenario's values. Where the scenario leaves a detail open, choose a concrete plausible value and state it; never reply that information is missing, except where the scenario itself says the input is empty. End your answer with a section headed exactly 'Final message:' that contains only the user-facing message.
assertions: The output contains exactly three distinct rewrites, each labelled with a different angle (hook, reply or repost)
Every rewrite uses only the supplied facts (a launch, six months of work); none invents a number, customer, revenue figure, dramatic event or product detail

The output recommends exactly one version and gives a reason
The output asks the user to confirm or supply specifics (what the product is, a real number) instead of inventing them
No rewrite contains hashtags, 'link in bio' or engagement bait such as 'RT if'
The output is draft text only: nothing states or implies the post was published
